title: Amai's Let Me Sleep - Sleeping Mode Plugin
description: Plugin that adds Sleeping mode (hibernate) to server
body:
# LET ME SLEEP
_LMS is a plugin that adds sleep mode to minecraft servers_
Reduces Ticks per seconds optimizes mob working etc.
##WHEN SLEEP MODE IS ACTIVATED?
When there is no players on server, mode turns on after delay in config :)
### Config.yml

```
hibernate_delay: 10 #in seconds (all)
medium_delay: 600
full_delay: 1200

tick_speed: 20 #normal Tickrate (TPS)
medium_tick_speed: 5 (when hibernate mode)
discord_webhook: "" #will be added soon
```
_hibernate delay - seconds to turn hibernate mode_

_medium_delay - Turns Medium Hibernate mode on_

_full_delay - Turns ULTRA hibernate mode on_

**LESS CPU USAGE , MORE EFFICIENCY!!!**

_sleepmode = hibernation_
